gate_lint_imports.label: gate_lint_imports
gate_lint_imports.command: uv run python tools/lint/lint_imports.py --policy import_policy.toml --exceptions import_exceptions.toml

gate_schema_ir.label: gate_schema_ir
gate_schema_ir.command: uv run python tools/diagnostics/gen_schema.py --models ir --check --output-dir schemas/snapshots

gate_schema_fabric.label: gate_schema_fabric
gate_schema_fabric.command: uv run python tools/diagnostics/gen_schema.py --models fabric --check --output-dir schemas/snapshots
